title: jo7171's Coil Chaos Mod
description: This mod just adds random things to the game like items, dimensions, mobs etc
body:
This mod adds random new features to the game. Here are some things that I've added:

**Initial Release**
- 1 Building Block
- 2 Natural Blocks
- 5 Tools and Utilities
- 1 Music Disc
- 6 Ingrediants
- 2 Enchantments
- 1 Mob
- 1 Dimension
- 1 Structure
- 1 Painting

**--PLEASE NOTE--**
- I plan to add more features in the future
- This is the first minecraft mod I've ever made
- Some new additions may have references to existing projects

Hope you enjoy the mod!
![Image of some of the new features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2e10adc63eaf7b4072edadacec0efcedd3f0d2b.png)
